description: This is a Java source file defining a REST controller class 'AccountController' for handling account and transaction-related HTTP requests in a banking application.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: REST controller for managing bank accounts and transactions, providing endpoints for retrieving account details, adding accounts, transferring funds, and fetching transaction history.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve account details by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new account for an existing customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to transfer funds between accounts.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all transactions for a specific account.
